description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::cord_internal::CordRepRing class and related string/cord structures, using Google Test framework.

classes.description: A helper class to hold a non-string_view representation of data, with methods to remove prefixes and suffixes.

classes.name: TestParam
classes.description: A struct to hold parameters for test configurations, including ownership and capacity options.

classes.name: CordRingTest
classes.description: Base test fixture for CordRepRing tests, managing reference counting of CordRep objects.

classes.name: CordRingTestWithParam
classes.description: Parameterized test fixture for CordRepRing, providing methods to create and manipulate ring buffers with different configurations.

classes.name: CordRingCreateTest
classes.description: Test fixture for creating CordRepRing instances from various inputs.

classes.name: CordRingSubTest
classes.description: Test fixture for subring operations and slicing.

classes.name: CordRingBuildTest
classes.description: Test fixture for building and modifying rings with various operations.

classes.name: CordRingCreateFromTreeTest
classes.description: Test fixture for creating rings from tree-like structures.

classes.name: CordRingBuildInputTest
classes.description: Test fixture for building rings with different input sharing modes.
